capabilities: Insert a link bookmark code block via the command palette and render it as a card
Insert a file bookmark code block for a vault-relative path and render it as a card
Optionally set an optional title for each bookmark
Block single-click or double-click open events in the file explorer for chosen file extensions
disambiguation: Not part of Obsidian's Bookmarks panel; bookmarks are code blocks embedded in notes that render as cards.
extras: The README is written in Chinese. File bookmarks only support files inside the vault and show an "invalid path" warning when the path cannot be resolved.
problem: Saving links and file references in Obsidian produces plain text or simple bookmark entries, not rich card-style previews inside notes.
summary: Card-style bookmark plugin that inserts link or vault-file bookmarks as code blocks that render as visual cards in notes.
